_meta.description: The Concord's bio-construct and infantry roster, with health, damage, drops and the counter to each one.

roster_policy: Concord military infantry, artillery and synths do not exist in the Fracture Year prequel. Only the early bio-constructs do.

enemies.name: Concord Dartbug
enemies.counter: P-20 or V-9. They come in packs, so they are an aim check and a momentum check at once.

enemies.name: Concord Ram
enemies.counter: Almost invincible to bullets, and it locks onto the player and never lets go. Avoid it, lure it into a pit or a crater, drop a weakened floor under it with an M-44, or shatter it head-on at 100 m/s. A Ram shattered at speed gives Lancer 25 points of decaying overheal.

enemies.name: Concord Stifler
enemies.counter: A bloated containment construct grown out of a ruptured Grown Seam. It dies into a caustic pool that burns for 5 HP a second and kills slide friction, so the floor after it is worse than the fight. An Adrenaline Stim-Pen clears the drag.

enemies.name: Concord Trooper
enemies.counter: Patrols checkpoints and alleys in squads with V-9 SMGs and timed fragmentation grenades. They are the baseline: expect them, flank them, and do not let a grenade pin the route.

enemies.name: Napalm Mortar
enemies.counter: An arcing incendiary crew locking down high ground, rooftops and cover lanes with lingering fire. Kill the crew before it fires and the canister can be thrown back as a fire-bomb. The M98 handles them from a long sightline.

enemies.name: Concord Overwatch
enemies.counter: A marksman on a high perch with an M98 and a visible cyan targeting laser. The laser is the warning. Forty-five HP a hit means one mistake is most of a health bar.

enemies.name: Concord Diver
enemies.counter: Pneumatic-legged and it vaults gaps to reach the roofs. A twenty HP strike, and it closes from above. The K-12 shreds them inside eight metres.

enemies.name: Concord Jammer
enemies.counter: A heavy spider-legged tripod projecting a static-air sphere that cancels thermals and jams Filament lock-ons. The sphere is the problem, so hit the rear pressure core. The M98 is the answer from range, the L-01 from close.

enemies.name: Warp Synth
enemies.counter: A post-Concord synth that relocates slowly, digs itself into the ground to anchor, charges a readable lock-on and fires hyper-fast projectiles. It is immune to bullets. It takes the AT-7, or the L-01, or a route it is not watching.

enemies.name: Concord Special Defense Operations Trooper
enemies.counter: Heavy elite containment troops in the high-security zones, and the ones who direct air support. They coordinate a squad instead of holding a corner, so the squad is the target.

enemies.name: Concord C-01 "Scatter"
enemies.counter: A low-altitude defence gunship, directed by an SDO Trooper. It saturates ground lanes, streets and rooftops with cluster napalm, and the answer is to leave the floor: walls, wall-kisses and Filament tethers. Kill the SDO and it goes home, or hit it with the AT-7 or the L-01.
